name: COVID Hospital Load
purpose: Tracks hospital and ICU pressure in each country over time

inputs.daily_deaths_7day_avg: Deaths reported per day, averaged over the last 7 days
inputs.icu_patients: Number of COVID patients in intensive care on that day
inputs.hospital_patients: Number of COVID patients in hospital on that day
inputs.ventilators_in_use: Number of ventilators in use on that day
inputs.staff_absences: Number of hospital staff off sick on that day
